description: A fully offline calculator. Perfect to explore flows without network access, and to learn how flow memory works.

input.name: body.a
input.description: First operand. Strings that look like numbers are accepted (useful with replacers such as {{ randomInt0_100 }}).

output.description: The operation performed and its result, rounded to PRECISION decimals.

memory.description: The result of the operation. Later steps can read it with {{ memory.lastResult }}.

add.example:
application: calculator
method: add
parameters:
  body:
    a: 2
    b: 40
test:
  status: 200
  body:
    result: 42

output.description: The operation performed and its result.

multiply.example:
application: calculator
method: multiply
parameters:
  body:
    a: "{{ memory.lastResult }}"
    b: 2

divide.description: Divides two numbers (a / b). Returns HTTP 400 with an error body when b is zero — useful to practice testing failure scenarios.

input.name: body.b
input.description: Divisor. Zero triggers a DIVISION_BY_ZERO error.

output.description: On success: the operation and its result. On division by zero: status 400 and an error object.

memory.description: The result of the operation (only on success).

divide.example:
application: calculator
method: divide
parameters:
  body:
    a: 1
    b: 0
test:
  status: 400
  body:
    error:
      code: DIVISION_BY_ZERO
